title: Error Sherpa: Guided Debugging Surface for Console
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Operators and SREs need a single, low-friction surface in the Redwood Console to analyze failed inference requests across rollouts and capacity tiers. Current flows scatter information (timelines in traces, payloads in raw logs, cost in billing dashboard). Goal: design a ‘guided debugging’ surface — Error Sherpa — that leads an engineer from incident signal to root cause hypotheses, with contextual cost and rollout awareness, and fast access to payload diffs and retry simulation.
comments: 2026-02-10 Aisha: Initial discovery synthesis completed. Interviewed 6 platform engineers and 4 customer SREs. Common needs: quick isolation (time window + model variant), replayable payload snapshot, retry origin tracing, and cost-per-failure metric for noisy customers.

2026-02-18 Marco: Low-fidelity flows sketched (timeline -> hypothesis lanes -> payload inspector -> simulated retry). Decided to show model variant, region, and capacity tier inline in the header to reduce context switching.

2026-02-25 Design critique (with PM/ENG): Feedback to simplify taxonomy. Remove ‘error severity’ buckets in first iteration; keep 6 taxonomy classes derived from runtime errors and model rejects (Authentication, Quota, Kernel OOM, KV Cache Miss, Model Reject/Length, Application Validation). ENG raised question about computing taxonomy in backend; added ENG-2187 dependency.

2026-03-02 Prototype 0.1 uploaded to Figma. Prototype focuses on two personas: a) incident responder doing ad-hoc triage and b) product engineer investigating regression tied to a rollout. Key interactions: time-range scrubber, variant filter, retry-simulate button, cost-impact estimator for selected time window.

2026-03-06 PM review (Lin Zhu): Asked for explicit linkage to rollouts (canary overlays) so users can correlate spike with a rollout step. Added a canary ribbon to timeline and a ‘Affected Rollouts’ module to the right rail.
2026-03-10 Accessibility pass: increased color contrast on error badges and added keyboard-first navigation for timeline scrubber. Noted requirement to expose ARIA labels for payload diff toggles.

2026-03-12 ENG review (Jules Becker): Concern about payload storage retention and privacy. Action: add a ‘view scrubbed payload’ toggle and a link to retention policy. Also asked to include a KMS audit breadcrumb when Private deployments are selected.

2026-03-14 Ready for design handoff. Preparing redlines and component spec. Need final decision on whether cost-per-failure should be absolute USD or tokens-based (PM prefers USD; cost team prefers tokens-per-1000). Filed follow-up PM-4189 for billing alignment.
